source.notes: The main Scholarships page (https://www.unibas.ch/en/Studies/Advice-and-Support/Funding/Scholarships.html) publishes no deadline itself and links to this dedicated Submission Deadlines page; it states 'the scholarship committee of the Senate grants supplementary scholarships for students enrolled at the University of Basel' and directs cantonal funding enquiries to the scholarship office of the parents' canton of residence. The Submission Deadlines page gives two semester-dependent cut-offs for a named group of funds with NO year stated, so they are recurring annual dates and no YYYY-MM-DD can be written without inventing a year. The '(*)' marker has no footnote text rendered on the page (checked the page text and title/footnote attributes), so its meaning could not be established - hence MEDIUM confidence. Classified ANNUAL/recurring rather than MONTH because the source states a day as well as a month.

records.title: Undergraduate International Study Grants (Massey University)
records.deadline_display: Status: Open. There is no separate application for the International Study Grant; you will be assessed at the point of admission.

source.as_of: 2027 academic year (grant Terms and Conditions dated 16/09/2026)
source.raw_extract:
For international students enrolling at Massey University for the first time in an undergraduate degree starting in any intake in 2027.

Scholarship overview

Status: Open

How to Apply

There is no separate application for the International Study Grant; you will be assessed at the point of admission, and, if successful, the grant will display on your admission offer of place. Apply to study at Massey University to be considered for this grant.
source.exact_deadline_wording: There is no separate application for the International Study Grant; you will be assessed at the point of admission
source.notes: Two independent official Massey sources were fetched and both show no application deadline. (1) The scholarship page above: Status: Open, with the quoted 'no separate application' wording and no Application dates block at all. (2) The linked official regulations '2027 International Study Grants' (https://www.massey.ac.nz/documents/2466/2027_International_Study_Grants_D8NcnBy.pdf), dated 16/09/2026, clause 4: '4.1 Students are not required to make a separate application for the study grant.' and '4.2 Eligibility will be confirmed when the student meets the entry requirements for the specific programme via an offer of place.' A keyword sweep of the regulations for deadline/closing/due/round/open found no date. Because the grant is assessed at the point of admission rather than on a fixed date, this is ROLLING and deadline_date stays null.
